posts.author: John Klayer
posts.content_md: One of the definitions of proactive is "controlling a situation by causing something to happen rather than waiting to respond to it after it happed" Do you want your State or Federal Government to take your lasers from you? We need to write to our State and Federal Law Makers and tell them that we have a legitamate use for high power lasers for holography before they try to ban them. In Georgia we have GeorgiaSpeaks.com to send ideas to our law makers. Maybe you have something like that in you state.

posts.author: Tom B.
posts.content_md: My instinct says "Let sleeping dogs lie" since I think they would find the idea of protecting the rights of artists laughable and would do the opposite, but half seriously, if we could get high power lasers classified as dangerous hunting weapons we could get the NRA on side and could then buy them at local hardware stores with minimal background checks. Don't they already offer laser sights, rangefinders etc? Just a thought.
